name: MALT MASHING BATH
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Malt Mashing Bath is specifically tailored for the brewing industry, food technology, and quality control laboratories. It is used to evaluate the extract yield of malt and barley by simulating Congress and Hartong procedures. Featuring motorized multi-jar agitators and precise PID temperature controls, it ensures brewmasters get highly accurate and repeatable enzymatic conversions for their quality checks.
features: Designed to work on Congress and Hartong mashing procedures
Available with 4, 6, 8, 10, or 12 stainless steel jars/agitators
Heavy duty motor with SS shafts and variable speed controller (15-150 rpm)
Precise PID temperature controller with optional Ramp & Soak functions
Audio/visual alarms and low water level safety cut-off

specifications.Stirrer Type: Heavy duty motor with SS shafts
specifications.Stirrer Speed: 15 to 150 rpm (Rotary type variable speed controller)
specifications.Safety Features: Low water level safety cut-off with alarm
